title: Maria Made It Magic — A Food Tour Unlike Any Other
text:
Where do I even begin? Our food tour with Maria was nothing short of phenomenal — a beautifully curated journey through flavors, stories, and sips that left us absolutely enchanted. Maria’s depth of knowledge about the local food and wine scene is remarkable, but what truly sets her apart is the genuine passion she brings to every stop. She doesn’t just guide you through a tour; she makes you feel like a welcomed guest at the table of a city she deeply loves.
The experience runs about three hours, so come hungry and wear your most comfortable walking shoes — you’ll want to savor every step and
author: 12earles

title: Great additional tour for your holiday
text: Had a lovely food tour with Christina around Seville . Her knowledge and passion for her city was great and the food stops were amazing  A lot of fun would recommend
author: Pokemon274

title: A lovely evening stroll in Seville with history & Tapas
text: Albania was a delight to be with. Spoke excellent english and happily answered our questions. We were a group of two couples and we wandered around old town Seville & Tirana. Sampling local speciality tapas along with Albania giving us snippets of history and pointing out historical landmarks. We had the upgraded drinks package which was well worth the extra for sampling the finer drinks . Would thoroughly recommend if you are a foodie.
author: Stay48600702307

title: Just book it!
text: Great experience! Maria was knowledgeable and so friendly. Super willing to accommodate food allergies and preferences.  So much great food! We always do a food tour in a new city. You will not be disappointed!

title: Maria Food tour
text: Maria was raised in city and could also draw on personal experiences. Walked at a reasonable pace. Maria learned and respected your food preferences.

title: Amazing day out!
text: Albania was an amazing host, her knowledge and experience added to what was a very special day. The local foods we were introduced to were all delicious and I highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to have an informative and personal introduction to Seville.
author: Cruiser33580241479

title: This was an excellent way to start my trip in Seville.
text: This was an excellent start to my trip to Seville. It was a “mystery” trip and none of my meals were included either at the hotel nor any of my tours. So, I had a free evening and thought what better way to try some local gastronomy. Cristina was an excellent guide and always found alternatives for my non-alcoholic and vegetarian palette. You will not starve on this tour and if you do, it’s your own fault! She started off with the churros (which I’m glad she did because I would not have been able to eat them at the end!) it was one of my bucket list Spanish food items. They did NOT disappoint,
author: W9524FMjenniferd
